title: A speech line
description: One entry a body can say out loud: a bubble over its head, drawn only while it is a Focal body (main.gd's _draw_bubbles), never a name plate. The id is speech.<key> and SimSpeech.say(world, ent, key, ticks) reads it by that key. `lines` is picked from with world.rng.stream("speech") so the same trigger does not say the same sentence every time. `ticks` defaults to SimSpeech.SAY_TICKS (60, three seconds) when absent; a scream sets its own (40). Every line must be digit-free and must name nobody -- the hardcore contract's ban on certainty the player has not earned, made mechanical by check_speech.gd's CONTENT lane. NOTE: the content validator is shallow -- it checks these top-level types and rejects unexpected top-level keys, but does not recurse into the `lines` array's own contents (each entry's type, non-emptiness); check_speech.gd's CONTENT lane holds that inner shape.

id.description: Stable namespaced id, speech.<key>. Permanent once shipped.

lines.description: One or more lines to draw from on the speech stream. Every one digit-free, names nobody, and carries no {name}-style placeholder -- check_speech.gd's CONTENT lane scans each one.

ticks.description: How long the bubble stands before speech.expire removes it. Defaults to SimSpeech.SAY_TICKS when absent.
